intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Leavenworth for 2026, and here is what he found: 10 family events, at least 4 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (The Santa Experience at Sagasu Family Martial Arts) through December 6 (A Christmas Carol matinee at the Performing Arts Center), with the Fort Leavenworth Tree Lighting at Zais Park (December 4) along the way, plus breakfast with Santa, popsicle stick gingerbread houses, Saturday with Santa and an indoor holiday market already live. Two of the new listings are in nearby Lansing. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Leavenworth

  • 10 Christmas events for kids in Leavenworth, counting 4 already live and 6 new ones
  • At least 4 free events: the Fort Leavenworth Tree Lighting, The Santa Experience at Sagasu, the Lansing Mayor's tree lighting and Santa Claus at Ten and Two Coffee
  • Meet Santa: Sagasu Family Martial Arts, Ten and Two Coffee in Lansing and the Fort Leavenworth Tree Lighting, plus Saturday with Santa and Breakfast with Santa already live
  • Theater and crafts: A Christmas Carol by River City Community Players and Family Art Day mosaic ornaments at First City Creatives
  • Lansing: the Mayor's Christmas Tree Lighting on November 29 and Santa Claus at Ten and Two Coffee on November 28
  • Season: November 28, 2026 to December 6, 2026 for the new listings

Planning a bigger day out? Leavenworth families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Kansas City, which covers Destination North Pole at Crown Center, Holiday Reflections at Union Station, the Plaza lighting ceremony and Santa visits at Zona Rosa.
